name: BONe: Deep learning software and revised 2D model to segment bone in micro-CT scans (BP-2D-03 dataset)
access: open (Dryad; scripted download requires Dryad API bearer token, or browser)
species: Mus musculus (6 scans, 12 mice); Lontra canadensis (11 label sets); Panthera pardus; Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris; Enhydra lutris
site: limb long bones (humerus, femur; otter also radius/ulna/tibia/fibula)
modality: lab micro-CT (Nikon XT H 225 ST); museum scans from MorphoSource
labels: 2D TIFF slice masks 'BP' (bone vs pores/background) made in Avizo 2024.2: Otsu threshold + filtering + ambient occlusion + manual correction; numeric class values not stated in README [UNR]

Mouse zips hold raw slices (_Scan, .xtekct/.info) + BP-label TIFFs; otter zips hold labels only (raw in dryad.b2rbnzsq4); ZMB sea otter labels only (scan on MorphoSource); capybara labels cover a subvolume only. Recommended <6 GB subset: README + 1R_1U_HF.zip + OMNH_Mammals_44262_HRU.zip (+ SNM_44262_HRU.zip from dryad.b2rbnzsq4) = ~4.13 GB. Leopard/capybara/sea-otter scans originate from MorphoSource; the CC0 waiver covers this deposit, but check the upstream MorphoSource media terms before commercial training on those three. Healthy adult bone only, no defects/implants.

name: Segmentation of cortical bone, trabecular bone, and medullary pores from micro-CT images using 2D and 3D deep learning models (otter limb bones)
access: open (Dryad; scripted download requires API bearer token, or browser)
species: Lontra canadensis (9 individuals, 38 bones, 12 scan sets)
modality: lab micro-CT, Nikon XT H 225 ST (Univ. Arkansas)
labels: CTP labels (cortical bone / trabecular bone / medullary pores) as TIFF slices; Avizo 2024.1: sigmoid remap, auto-threshold + manual check, top-hat for thin trabeculae, ambient occlusion for pores, shrink-wrap mask (Herbst 2021) to split cortical vs trabecular. Also model predictions (BP/CTP 2D/3D). Class values not stated [UNR]

name: MicroCT Data of Mice for Osteoarthritis Biomarkers Project (Kitware HASI benchmark), v1.0.1 per-file release
species: Mus musculus (factor VIII-deficient haemophilia model + controls)
site: knee (distal femur / proximal tibia, multiple bones)
labels: AUTO-* automatic multi-bone labels for all 28 knees (bones-label, label, per-bone bone1..N NRRD); MAN-907-L manual label map with 8 anatomical compartments (1 epiphysis, 2 growth plate, 3 spongiosa region, 4 cortical metaphysis, 5 metaphysis medullary cavity, 6 diaphysis medullary cavity, 7 diaphysis cortical shell, 8 shaft rest) + MAN-SegmentationFinal.seg.nrrd
notes: Original data: Lau AG et al. 2014 Haemophilia 20(5):716-722 (PMC4396845; article DOI [UNR]). v1.0.0 = 10.5281/zenodo.3890144 (single 35 GB zip). 28 ORIG zips 0.64-1.9 GB each. Only one knee has manual labels; AUTO labels are algorithm output (pseudo-labels). Label files downloaded to data/raw/zenodo_3909552_mouse_oa_knee/ and verified (NRRD, gzip, 1392x983x829, 0.01 mm). Haemophilic arthropathy, not a defect model.

name: MicroCT Trabecular Bone Samples for Trabecular Thickness and Separation Measures
species: [UNR] (sample IDs BMLPL_xxx REF/BML; likely human bone-marrow-lesion study)
labels: Binary trabecular segmentation (values 0/127, int16) for 8 samples, 100^3 voxels; reference distance-transform maps for Tb.Th and Tb.Sp from Scanco IPL and from Python (ORMIR_XCT)
notes: Ideal for validating OsteoQuant morphometry (Tb.Th/Tb.Sp) against Scanco IPL reference maps. Two files downloaded and verified. Voxel-size discrepancy between description and header must be resolved before using as absolute reference. Not useful for segmentation training (no greyscale).

name: 3D Cortical Bone and Trabecular Bone Structure [synthetic data, simple, capsule shell model]
labels: Ground truth 4 labels: 0 background, 11 cortical bone, 21 trabecular bone, 31 cavity (TIFF slices)
notes: gt.zip downloaded and verified (8034 entries incl. __MACOSX). Synthetic only: for pipeline/unit tests, not for real-world accuracy claims.

name: Data for: SPROUT - multi-class segmentation of volumetric images (dog forelimb, mammal skull, foraminifera micro-CT)
license: CC-BY-4.0 (8 mammal-skull scans keep their original MorphoSource licences)
species: Canis familiaris (15 forelimbs); 11 mammal skulls; foraminifera
labels: Reference multi-class segmentations made with SPROUT + manual correction; 9 dog forelimbs with Biomedisa-interpolation reference; baselines (watershed, Biomedisa, nnInteractive, SAM, SAM2)
notes: Code: github.com/EchanHe/SPROUT; paper DOI [UNR]. Labels are per-bone instance-like classes (individual bones), not bone-vs-defect. Good cheap cross-dataset test of bone foreground segmentation. README downloaded. Commercial-use detail: allowed (dog forelimb/foraminifera); unclear for MorphoSource-derived skulls

name: A micro-CT of a human skull (raw projections, reconstruction, bone segmentation)
labels: Bone segmentation (semi-manual per arXiv 2202.11519) as NRRD
notes: Single specimen, human cranial bone; ingestion test for large NRRD and one extra bone-mask pair. Skip the 15.3 GB projections zip.

name: PID2020-113790RB-I00: micro-CT of bone lengthening (distraction osteogenesis) on ovine metatarsus
species: Ovis aries (6 animals, 1 per time point)
modality: ex vivo micro-CT, Yxlon Y.Cougar SMT, 50 kV/90 uA, x4
notes: Already known. Publication: Blazquez-Carmona et al. 2024 Front Bioeng Biotechnol 12 (DOI [UNR]). Cross-sectional time series (different animals), not longitudinal in the same animal. data/raw/zenodo_17255310/ exists with 18DAYS complete and 161DAYS partially downloaded by another process (not by this survey). Zeiss/Xradia .txm (OLE2 compound file) requires a TXM reader.

name: Micro-CT data of bone substitutes (PLA and PLA-chitosan)
notes: Minimal metadata (one-line description). Polymer scaffold without bone; only useful for scaffold-porosity module tests.

name: Data from: 3D Printed Voronoi Hydroxyapatite Scaffolds with Engineered Trabecular Orientation
notes: Downloaded; RAR v5 archive (needs unrar/7z, not extracted). Useful for scaffold porosity / strut thickness / anisotropy tests (orientations 0-90 deg + ISO).

name: Polyacrylonitrile-Chitosan IPN composite scaffolds mimicking trabecular bone (source data)
notes: Publication 10.1016/j.mtchem.2024.102253. Scaffold porosity tests only.

name: In vivo Study of the Effect of Composition and Implantation Site on Scaffold Degradation Rate (6 Zenodo records, TaOx-loaded PCL/PLGA)
notes: Publication 10.1038/s43246-026-01308-5. The only verified open longitudinal in vivo micro-CT found, but soft-tissue implant sites and 38-50 GB per record exceed our disk budget.

name: PEMF stimulates mineralization in a 3D ring culture model of osteogenesis
notes: In vitro; 20 GB per zip.

name: bone-lab cranial defect micro-CT slices (Kaggle chzpan/bone-lab)
labels: expert circle ROI (defect centre) per slice; 5606 slices / 65 samples
notes: Described at github.com/ChZPan/CT-image-DeepLearningRegression (Univ. Toronto Bone Interface Group). Only calvarial-defect labelled set found, but licence unknown.

name: LumbarSR: paired clinical CT and photon-counting micro-CT of human lumbar vertebrae
labels: BoneMask ROI volumes registered to Micro-PCCT
notes: Paper 10.1038/s41597-026-07748-5 (from Sci Data URL). Split zip (all 7 parts needed, ~26 GB). Multi-resolution trabecular benchmark; dry human bone, not preclinical.

name: Trabecular bone - screw interaction: micro-CT models and experimental push-in results
site: trabecular bone cores with inserted screw
labels: voxel models of bone before screw insertion and bone + screw after insertion (segmented); force/displacement curves
notes: Implant-in-bone segmented models usable for BIC / peri-implant morphometry tests. Single 13 GB zip; MATLAB .mat. Related: Steiner et al. 2017 J Orthop Res 35(11):2415 (DOI [UNR]). readMe downloaded.

name: Micro-CT scans of unloaded and loaded glenoid bone used for DVC
labels: rigidly registered, bone-masked volumes; 6 repeated unloaded scans
notes: Repeat scans with repositioning: good for scan-rescan precision of morphometry (QC module).

name: HR-pQCT demo images (Scanco ISQ)
notes: NON-COMMERCIAL. Only value is ISQ reader testing; restrict to internal research after legal review; never use for training or ship as test fixtures.

name: Cone-beam CT dataset of a chicken bone at 4 dose levels (projections)
notes: Noise/dose robustness testing; requires own reconstruction.

name: LumVBCanSeg: lumbar vertebral body cancellous bone segmentation (clinical CT)
labels: cancellous bone masks L1-L5 (3 physicians + senior review)
notes: Clinical resolution; out of scope for micro-CT.

name: FEMHALS: multiscale imaging and mechanical testing of 94 human proximal femora (QCT, uCT)
notes: Multi-resolution human femur; access request needed.

name: Murine femur micro-CT and biomechanical datasets for an ovariectomy-induced osteoporosis model
modality: ex vivo micro-CT, Bruker SkyScan 1172, NRecon
notes: Paper 10.1038/s41597-021-01012-8. Each animal ~5.5 GB RAR (raw projection TIFFs + reconstructed BMP + test data). Good for SkyScan/NRecon ingestion + cross-scanner generalisation; RAR needs unrar.

name: Micro-CT reconstructions of tibiae of stem cell transplanted osteogenesis imperfecta mice
species: Mus musculus (21: WT, oim/oim, oim/oim + hAFSC)
modality: micro-CT, 991 x 8-bit BMP per sample + PLY mesh
notes: Paper 10.1038/sdata.2018.100. Slice zips total 9.79 GB; PLY meshes ~0.2 GB each. Disease (brittle bone) phenotype gives cross-dataset shift.

name: MicroCT Dataset of mouse tibiae for DVC precision analyses (repeated scans ex vivo and in vivo)
access: request (images on Sheffield file-store; contact author)
notes: Also 10.15131/shef.data.5562529.v1 (integration-time study, results only). Repeated in vivo scans relevant to longitudinal module.

name: MiceBoneChallenge: micro-CT public dataset for growth-plate detection (83 mouse femurs)
notes: Paper says data 'is being made public'; no URL/licence found.

name: Hereon P05 SRuCT of Mg-xGd / Ti screws in rat bone (segmentation studies)
labels: (in papers) residual material / degradation layer / bone / background

name: Bone Metal 3D Segmentation (clinical CT with metallic implants)
notes: Sparse, unclear provenance; clinical CT.

name: MarrowQuant: H&E whole-bone sections (mouse femur/tibia/vertebra/sternum/tail; human iliac crest)
species: Mus musculus C57BL/6 (aging, irradiation aplasia); Homo sapiens (BM biopsies)
labels: 1 ROI per image (per IDR annotation CSV); quantification of bone, adipocyte ghosts, haematopoietic, interstitial compartments in paper
notes: Paper 10.3389/fendo.2020.00480. 205 OME-TIFFs, 79 MB-11 GB each (~353 GB total). Bone-specific H&E with marrow; labels are ROIs, not pixel masks (verify ROI content in OMERO). EBI FTP over HTTPS intermittently resets; retry.

name: Reconstructing 3D histological structures (human jaw trabecular bone serial sections)

notes: Commercially usable nuclei dataset; not bone-specific. Paper DOI [UNR].

name: Postnatal articular cartilage maturation in a goat model (H&E histology + synchrotron phase-contrast tomography)
